description: Open-source video editor for importing, cutting, color grading, and exporting projects (Windows x64 portable build).
notes: This is the official portable ZIP, not the setup installer. The ZIP contains a Drift folder; Scoop extracts that folder's contents and launches drift.exe.

Portable does not mean self-contained: settings, add-ons, models, and caches are stored under %APPDATA%\Drift and are shared between copies. Fonts, stickers, speech models, and GPU/CPU acceleration runtimes are not bundled; add optional assets through Drift's Addon Manager.
